# SetRack

> Android gym log. Fully offline: no account, no ads, no trackers and no internet
> permission. Data lives only on the phone. Free.
> Last reviewed: 2026-11-14.

## Verifiable facts (checked 2026-11-14)

- Version 1.0.11 on Google Play (versionCode 344).
- How it works: pick a routine or a free session, log weight and reps, check each muscle's missing sets and each exercise's progress.
- Sections: features, how it works, questions, data with the full policy, support.

- The APK declares no INTERNET permission; its only system permission is VIBRATE (the tick when logging a set).
- Exercises, sets and weights are stored only in local storage.
- Manual backup file in Downloads, restore from that file, and CSV export.
- 104 base exercises with muscle and equipment; users can add their own.
- 8 colour themes, two of them light.
- Three starter programs (Upper/Lower, Push/Pull/Legs, Full body) with planned sets per exercise.
- Estimated 1RM (Brzycki); progress by week, month, quarter or year.
- Suggests exercises by the sets each muscle still needs this week.
- The app and this website are both in 11 languages (Spanish, English, Portuguese (Brazil), German, French, Italian, Polish, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese). Kilos or pounds.
- Status: available on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.setrack.app
